title: long_stats_slopes
description: Computes slopes of statistics in a longitudinal study for each subject from processed results, outputting to designated directories for further analysis.

qdec_table.description: QDEC table file specifying the subjects and time points.
qdec_table.title: QDEC Table File

stats_file.description: The stats file, e.g. aseg.stats or lh.aparc.stats.
stats_file.title: Stats File

measure.description: The stats measure (e.g. volume, thickness, mean, std).
measure.title: Measure

subjects_dir.description: Full path to FreeSurfer subjects directory.
subjects_dir.title: Subjects Directory

do_avg.description: Compute and output the temporal average.
do_avg.title: Compute Temporal Average

do_pc1fit.description: Compute and output the percent change with respect to tp1 from linear fit.
do_pc1fit.title: Compute Percent Change (Fit)

do_pc1.description: Compute and output the percent change with respect to tp1.
do_pc1.title: Compute Percent Change

do_spc.description: Compute and output the symmetric percent change with respect to temporal average.
do_spc.title: Compute Symmetric Percent Change

do_stack.description: Compute and output tables showing the time series (row per time point).
do_stack.title: Compute Time Series

resid.description: Residual timepoint to export (pass 1 for tp1, etc., pass 0 for average).
resid.title: Residual Timepoint

time_var.description: Variable name for time column variable (e.g., age) in QDEC table.
time_var.title: Time Variable

generic_time.description: Time points are ordered in QDEC file; assume time=1,2,3...
generic_time.title: Generic Time

out_avg.description: Filename to store temporal average in <template>/stats/<OUT_AVG>.
out_avg.title: Output Temporal Average

out_pc1fit.description: Filename to store percent change to tp1fit in <template>/stats/<OUT_PC1FIT>.
out_pc1fit.title: Output Percent Change (Fit)

out_pc1.description: Filename to store percent change to tp1 in <template>/stats/<OUT_PC1>.
out_pc1.title: Output Percent Change

out_spc.description: Filename to store symmetric percent change in <template>/stats/<OUT_SPC>.
out_spc.title: Output Symmetric Percent Change

out_stack.description: Filename to store stacked measure file in <template>/stats/<OUT_STACK>.
out_stack.title: Output Stacked Measures

stack_avg.description: Full filename to stack temporal average tables.
stack_avg.title: Stacked Temporal Average

stack_rate.description: Full filename to stack rate tables.
stack_rate.title: Stacked Rate Tables

stack_pc1fit.description: Full filename to stack percent change to tp1fit tables.
stack_pc1fit.title: Stacked Percent Change (Fit)

stack_pc1.description: Full filename to stack percent change to tp1 tables.
stack_pc1.title: Stacked Percent Change

stack_spc.description: Full filename to stack symmetric percent change tables.
stack_spc.title: Stacked Symmetric Percent Change

stack_resid.description: Full filename to stack residual tables.
stack_resid.title: Stacked Residual Tables
